Definition: Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East
BiblicalUsage: Ophir = "reducing to ashes"; 1) eleventh son of Joktan; 2) a land or city in southern Arabia in Solomon's trade route where gold evidently was traded for goods; 3) characteristic of fine gold; 4) fine gold
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
